description: Enhanced boundary coverage for the named-marker routing filter with caller-chosen outcomes. Covers: a non-matching marker yielding the configured on-mismatch decision when that decision is NEUTRAL (rather than the native DENY); a matching marker yielding a non-ACCEPT on-match decision (NEUTRAL) to prove the outcome tokens are fully caller-driven; an explicit match yielding the configured ACCEPT; and the no-marker case yielding the configured on-mismatch decision when on_mismatch is ACCEPT, proving a missing marker is treated as a mismatch and the outcome is not hard-coded.
